q_01.name: Brick guardhouse
q_01.why: A brick facade has an open doorway, a barred window, and an iron gate beside it.
q_01.odd: The small glowing object in the wall recess is hard to identify.

q_02.name: Building facade with recessed windows
q_02.why: Two rectangular openings reveal brown paneled interiors behind a gray and green wall beside the street.
q_02.odd: The opening on the right has a streaked panel that’s hard to identify.

q_03.name: Storage room
q_03.why: Wooden crates and a barrel sit on a stone floor beneath a low ceiling.
q_03.odd: Thick black borders surround the view, and the room is very dark.

q_04.name: Railway yard
q_04.why: Parallel tracks with wooden sleepers run past a green-striped railcar and brick buildings.
q_04.odd: The left track appears to end at a blank wall.

q_05.name: Steam locomotive
q_05.why: Two large spoked wheels are joined by a side rod beneath a rust-colored body.
q_05.odd: The wheels look painted onto a flat wall.

q_06.name: Brick-Walled Railway Cutting
q_06.why: Rails and wooden sleepers run between tall brick walls beneath an open sky.
q_06.odd: The wall signs are too pixelated to read clearly, and the far end is nearly black.

q_07.name: Orange door in an exterior wall
q_07.why: An orange door with a metal handle sits beside two windows in a green-striped wall.
q_07.odd: The sky looks like a mottled red ceiling.

q_08.name: Rail tunnel service gate
q_08.why: Rusty rails lead to a broad, ribbed metal gate set into brick walls.
q_08.odd: The rails appear to end flush against the gate.

q_09.name: Brick passage beside a railcar
q_09.why: A barrel sits on the stone walkway beside a gray carriage with visible wheel arches.
q_09.odd: Deep shadows make the wheels hard to distinguish.

q_10.name: Steam locomotive at a platform
q_10.why: A tall smokestack, visible wheels, and a railcar sit beside a paved platform.
q_10.odd: A horned skull decorates the locomotive beneath a fiery red sky.

q_11.name: Crate storage room
q_11.why: Wooden crates sit on a stone-tiled floor beneath a plank ceiling.

q_12.name: Industrial corridor
q_12.why: Metal columns and low barriers line a gray-tiled passage overlooking a courtyard.
q_12.odd: The far wall and doorways are hard to make out in the shadows.

q_13.name: Moonlit wooden walkway
q_13.why: Wooden planks run beside a timber-framed wall and low railing, with the moon visible overhead.
q_13.odd: The far doorway is too dark to see into.

q_14.name: Iron gate overlooking a courtyard
q_14.why: Tall iron bars frame a paved area with brick walls, a barrel, and a red sky.
q_14.odd: Deep shadows obscure details near the base of the gate.

q_15.name: Brick-walled industrial walkway
q_15.why: A gray stone walkway runs beside red brick walls, with metal paneling visible on the left.
q_15.odd: The wooden inset is too dark to tell whether it is a boarded window.

q_16.name: Wood-paneled room with grandfather clock
q_16.why: High-backed chairs and wooden furniture sit beside a tall clock with a round face.
q_16.odd: The small framed picture near the ceiling is too pixelated to identify.

q_17.name: Wood-paneled hallway
q_17.why: A long, carpeted passage has wood trim, curtained windows, and chairs along one wall.
q_17.odd: The carpet pattern is so busy it obscures the floor’s edges.

q_18.name: Bar interior
q_18.why: Bottles line a wooden counter, and red stools stand on a checkerboard floor.
q_18.odd: Two nearly identical figures appear to overlap beside the stools.

q_19.name: Wooden Bench in Brick Room
q_19.why: A blocky wooden bench with a low backrest sits on gray stone tiles in front of dark brick walls.
q_19.odd: The tiny symbol in the wall frame is hard to make out.
